newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour rejects privatisation of London 'tube'.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour rejects privatisation of London 'tube'.

text.p: Britain's main opposition Labour Party on Thursday reaffirmed its opposition to Conservative proposals to sell off London's Underground rail network, saying it would be a poor deal for taxpayer and passenger alike.
"The Conservative plan for the wholesale privatisation of London Underground is not the answer," Labour's manifesto for the May 1 election said.
"Much-needed investment would be delayed. The core public responsibilities of the Underground would be threatened."
Labour said it planned instead a new public-private partnership to improve the 'tube', safeguard its commitment to the public interest and guarantee value for money to taxpayers and passengers.
